selected_gaps.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This is the most load-bearing method gap because an adoption screen is useful only if its cheap evidence preserves the later net-benefit decision on the user's task. The controlled-diagnostic move isolates one paper-to-task context mismatch at a time while holding the task, scorer, model, and baseline fixed, yielding a runnable probe of benefit-sign preservation rather than another fidelity score.

selected_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier estimates net benefit after execution cost, adaptation effort, and regressions on task dimensions outside the paper's headline metric are deducted from gross performance gain.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This sibling uses the same shared evaluation because a boundary defined on gross score can reverse once user-specific costs and locked regression dimensions are included. The controlled-diagnostic move holds the cost accounting rule fixed across each matched pair and measures where cost-adjusted benefit, rather than the paper's headline metric, crosses zero.

deliverable_coverage: method - the anchor gap's controlled_diagnostic_design pattern yields the runnable matched-perturbation probe and its inside/outside applicability decision.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved paper tests whether tasks derived from the paper or skill, or selected by a fixed reproduction benchmark, are representative enough of the user's target-task distribution to support an adoption decision.
deferred_gaps.reason: BoundaryProbe uses an independent user-distribution coreset and a conservative covered-mass gate, but a general representativeness study across artifact-derived and fixed benchmark distributions would be a separate paper.

deferred_gaps.gap: No retrieved frontier quantifies decision calibration across paper families, user tasks, agent models, environments, and probe budgets, including false-adoption and false-rejection rates.
deferred_gaps.reason: A cross-family, cross-model calibration campaign would expand the focused task-conditioned boundary probe into a generic benchmark; it is deferred until the single-task applicability instrument is validated.
